name: Hero auth-card trio
purpose: Show three different real login shapes at once, so the product's flexibility is visible before a single word of body copy is read.

cards.note: Three instances of ONE shared component, differing only by props and the two brand custom properties.

sharedOnceRule.statement: All three cards, plus the customiser's preview, are rendered by a single AuthCard implementation — 4 instances site-wide. A generator must not fork the card.

geometry.layout: A centred flex row inside the `cards` grid area with perspective:1000px.
geometry.sideCardTiltNote: The static translateX(+/-180px) was measured IDENTICAL at 1280 and at 390, so it is not a narrow-width-only offset as CLONE_SPEC assumed.
geometry.correction: ia.json describes this as '344x386, 392x459, 344x386 at x=100/444/836'. Those were original-site measurements; the clone's own CSS gives all three cards one width (320px / 392px at >=640px) in a centred flex row with no absolute x positions. Cite the CSS values.

scrubbed.denominatorNote: 459 is the scrubbed card's own height, so the denominator is vh + 459 — NOT a constant. An earlier hardcoded 1303 was exact only at vh=844 and ran 4.3% steep at 1280x900.
scrubbed.measureParentReason: getBoundingClientRect() on the scrubbed element reflects the transform just written, which feeds back and stretches the mapping by 1/(1-slope).
